parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the IoT card.

This parameter is required only when the queried IoT card has been canceled (i.e., DestroyCard is true).

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/425529.html API and view the instance ID (VsimInstanceId) of the IoT card in the response parameters

您可以调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/425529.html在返回参数中查看物联网卡的实例ID（VsimInstanceId）
